pipeline.title: Merck’s MASH hopeful efinopegdutide wins in mid-stage study
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co. revealed results from a mid-stage clinical trial showing its GLP-1 and glucagon receptor co-agonist efinopegdutide resolved cases of MASH compared with placebo without worsening liver fibrosis.

pipeline.title: Veradermics wraps phase 3 program in men with 'better-than-expected' hair growth at 1 year
pipeline.summary: In a new readout of 12-month data, Veradermics' oral minoxidil delivered the best hair growth data of its phase 3 program so far alongside solid one-year safety data.

pipeline.title: J&J’s Icotyde pill drives biologic-like efficacy in psoriatic arthritis despite high-dose miss
pipeline.summary: Icotyde's strong phase 3 data in biologic-naïve patients with psoriatic arthritis were stained by one disappointment as a high dose missed statistical significance on the primary endpoint.

pipeline.title: Zura scraps hidradenitis suppurativa program after phase 2 miss, sinking stock
pipeline.summary: Zura Bio’s tibulizumab has flunked a phase 2 hidradenitis suppurativa trial, prompting the biotech to end development in the indication while continuing studies in other settings.

pipeline.title: J&J-backed Delix drums up $100M series C for non-hallucinatory psychedelic for depression
pipeline.summary: Delix Therapeutics has raised $100 million in a series C round backed by the likes of Johnson & Johnson to advance a phase 2-ready non-hallucinatory psychedelic therapy for depression.

pipeline.title: Kyorin pens $140M deal for Japan rights to Edesa’s phase 3 respiratory drug
pipeline.summary: Kyorin Pharmaceutical is paying $12 million upfront for the Japan rights to Edesa Biotech’s anti-TLR4 antibody to treat acute respiratory distress syndrome.

pipeline.title: Translating Phase II success into Phase III readiness takes more than scale
pipeline.summary: The move from Phase II to Phase III is often treated as a clinical milestone, when it is actually a development-wide transition.

pipeline.title: Vir’s phase 3 hepatitis delta win fuels push to eclipse Gilead
pipeline.summary: Vir Biotechnology’s phase 3 trial in chronic hepatitis delta has hit its primary endpoint, giving the biotech the first piece of the package it needs to file for FDA approval next year.

pipeline.title: Valneva sees LimmaTech vaccine reduce Shigella infections in phase 2 test
pipeline.summary: Valneva’s Shigella vaccine has been shown to reduce cases of intestinal infection, hitting the key endpoint of a phase 2 trial.

pipeline.title: Lilly looks to gird Foundayo label after late-stage win in sleep apnea
pipeline.summary: Lilly's oral GLP-1 Foundayo significantly reduced sleep apnea severity in a phase 3 study presented at the AHA Scientific Sessions on Monday. Now, the pharma is approaching the FDA in hopes of a label expansion.

pipeline.title: Moderna’s norovirus vaccine plans in limbo in wake of phase 3 miss
pipeline.summary: Moderna has scrapped plans to enroll a new cohort in a phase 3 trial of its norovirus vaccine and instead will meet with regulators to decide on next steps.

pipeline.title: Recent Lisata prize Marea touts ‘exciting’ lipid disorder phase 2 win, mulls obesity potential
pipeline.summary: Fresh from a merger with oncology drugmaker Lisata Therapeutics, cardiometabolic biotech Marea Therapeutics has revealed results from the first part of a phase 2b study showing its drug candidate MAR001 significantly reduced levels of fat in the blood of patients with hypertrigly

pipeline.title: AHA: Boehringer aims for 2027 survodutide submission after obesity drug passes cardio test
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim is gearing up to take survodutide to regulators next year after the obesity drug proved its cardiovascular credentials in its latest phase 3 study.

pipeline.title: Faeth’s phase 2 data power oral combo forward in cancer targeted by ADC heavyweights
pipeline.summary: Faeth Therapeutics’ endometrial cancer prospect has cleared the phase 2 efficacy bar, emboldening the biotech to forge ahead with efforts to establish the oral therapy in a field dominated by injectables.

pipeline.title: ANI makes $560M play for Egetis and its approved orphan drug Emcitate
pipeline.summary: ANI Pharmaceuticals is handing over $560 million to expand its rare disease business with the proposed buyout of Swedish drugmaker Egetis Therapeutics and its lead asset Emcitate, the first and only approved treatment for MCT8 deficiency.

pipeline.title: Rezera revs up for $181M IPO to fund phase 3 trial of NLRP3 inhibitor
pipeline.summary: Rezera—the new name for NodThera—is aiming for a $181 million IPO to take its NLRP3 inhibitor into phase 3 trials for a cardiovascular disease.

pipeline.title: Use Kidney Genetics to Strengthen Clinical Trial Design
pipeline.summary: Listen to the podcast to learn how genotype-defined kidney disease data can inform trial populations, endpoints and enrollment strategy.

pipeline.title: Bayer wins FDA nod for a new kind of blood thinner
pipeline.summary: Sunharbo’s U.S. approval is the first for a “Factor XIa” inhibitor, an anticipated class of medicines seen as a possible step forward in stroke prevention.

pipeline.title: Vir hepatitis D drug succeeds in first pivotal study
pipeline.summary: A program that’s survived Vir’s pivot away from infectious disease research hit all of its study objectives and appeared more potent than a rival drug also in late-stage development.

pipeline.title: Argenx to buy peptide platform in potentially billion-dollar deal
pipeline.summary: For $550 million up front, Argenx will take control of Unnatural Products’ “macrocyclic peptide” technology and direct it to develop oral, durable medicines for serious immune-mediated diseases.

pipeline.title: FDA opens safety probe into Novartis’ Zolgensma over potential tumor risks
pipeline.summary: In its Nov. 6 communique about its Zolgensma safety probe, the FDA also flagged two recent reports of other gene therapy candidates where AAV vector integration drove tumor formation.

pipeline.title: Ramaswamy’s biotech baggage haunted his political run
pipeline.summary: A pivotal Alzheimer’s trial tied to Vivek Ramaswamy’s political rise is a tale of failed endpoints.

pipeline.title: Sanofi-backed Windward breezes toward $204M IPO to fund respiratory pipeline from China
pipeline.summary: Windward Bio is sailing toward the public markets with the aim of raising over $200 million in proceeds to fund two respiratory drugs licensed from China.

pipeline.title: Spruce spins out preclinical endocrinology program into newly formed Adrenyx
pipeline.summary: Spruce Biosciences is spinning out a preclinical endocrinology program into a newly formed subsidiary called Adrenyx Biosciences, supported with up to $50 million from an unnamed investor.

pipeline.title: Moderna moves UK commercial digs to heart of London's 'knowledge quarter'
pipeline.summary: Sticking by the strong relationship it’s fostered with the U.K., mRNA specialist Moderna is relocating its home base in the country.

pipeline.title: State incentives for commercial-stage life sciences companies
pipeline.summary: Factor incentives into expansion plans early to improve site decisions, manage commitments and free capital for what comes next.

pipeline.title: Making the ‘impossible’ executable in life sciences construction
pipeline.summary: Why early technical expertise matters when complex life sciences projects challenge convention.

pipeline.title: Argenx inks $1.15B Unnatural Products buyout to expand in oral peptides
pipeline.summary: Argenx has struck a deal to acquire Unnatural Products for $550 million upfront, snapping up the Merck & Co.- and Novartis-partnered biotech to add oral peptide capabilities.

pipeline.title: Hims & Hers inks deal with Eli Lilly to offer branded weight loss drugs
pipeline.summary: Hims & Hers struck a deal with Eli Lilly to offer the drugmaker’s branded obesity treatments through its online health and wellness platform.

pipeline.title: CMS makes it official, codifying Medicare drug price negotiations established under IRA
pipeline.summary: Against a backdrop of repeated industry challenges in court, the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services is locking in the drug price negotiation framework established under the Biden-era Inflation Reduction Act.

pipeline.title: ‘Cancer hasn't seen this molecule before’: Onchilles’ injection shows potential for solid tumors
pipeline.summary: The San Diego-based biotech has shown that when its vaccine-like therapeutic, N17350, is injected directly into the tumor, the candidate is even able to clear cancer lesions that are distant from the injected tumor.

pipeline.title: Actor Jeremy Pope joins ViiV's 'PrEP Wisdom' campaign to educate on long-acting PrEP options
pipeline.summary: ViiV Healthcare has tapped a new mind for its “PrEP Wisdom” campaign, with Tony Award-winning actor and fashion icon Jeremy Pope joining in on the education and awareness messaging around long-acting injectable pre-exposure prophylaxis options.

pipeline.title: Agentic AI Is Rewriting The Pharma Marketing Playbook
pipeline.summary: AI is transforming how the pharma industry approaches drug development.

pipeline.title: Novartis reveals cancer cases possibly linked to gene therapy Zolgensma
pipeline.summary: The FDA is now investigating the risk of malignancy associated with Zolgensma and is “evaluating whether regulatory action is appropriate.”

pipeline.title: Moderna's COVID vaccine carries stellar Q3 revenue beat
pipeline.summary: Moderna posted $1.3 billion in third-quarter revenue, vastly surpassing analyst estimates and avoiding a predicted loss. The Q3 results suggest COVID can still make for a strong business plan.

pipeline.title: There's more than one way to build a biotech
pipeline.summary: Axiom Biosciences is taking an unconventional approach to raising capital and developing new therapies. In this episode of "The Top Line," founder and CEO Remo Moomiaie-Qajar joins Fierce Biotech's Marissa Russo to discuss the company's financing strategy, drug development approa

pipeline.title: Novartis confirms more reported tumor cases in Zolgensma patients as SMA groups seek details
pipeline.summary: Novartis has confirmed a number of new cases of tumors that developed in children treated with its gene therapy Zolgensma after a series of notices from spinal muscular atrophy advocacy groups this week.

pipeline.title: Lilly, Hims reach GLP-1 deal; Alnylam sales chief to step down
pipeline.summary: The deal is part of a course change for Hims, which had previously sold knockoff GLP-1 drugs. Elsewhere, a medicine Servier recently acquired failed a key trial and Ultragenyx announced staff cuts.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Boehringer’s $7.4B SBP deal; Fresenius’ sweeping biosim pact; A $1B molecular glue bet
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim entered a potential $7.4 billion oncology-focused deal with China's SBP Group, as Fresenius formed a 37-asset biosimilar development collaboration with WuXi Biologics, and Evommune licensed an inflammatory disease molecular glue candidate from China's Hinova

pipeline.title: When China Fits a Global Clinical Development Strategy
pipeline.summary: Explore how China-generated evidence, patient access, regulatory planning and local expertise can strengthen global clinical programs.

pipeline.title: This week in charts: 3 drug launches Wall Street is watching
pipeline.summary: The latest installment in BioPharma Dive’s visualization-focused series features a look at investors’ response to a trio of medicines highlighted in quarterly earnings this week.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly forces compounding rival to shed weight loss claims
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has successfully challenged Good Life Meds’ claims about the health benefits and personalization of a compounded tirzepatide product.

pipeline.title: Merck abandons Sutro-partnered IL-2 drug in ‘routine pipeline prioritization’
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co. has called time on a Sutro Biopharma-partnered IL-2 agonist that was being tested for solid tumors.

pipeline.title: Siemens Healthineers rebrands and carves out in vitro diagnostics biz
pipeline.summary: Siemens Healthineers will carve out its in vitro diagnostics business as a standalone company operating under the name Olyrian Diagnostics.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Novo's longtime CFO to hang up gloves as Galderma exec steps in
pipeline.summary: Novo's CFO of the past 8 years is taking his leave at the end of the year. Alnylam is on the hunt for a new commercial chief amid news of Tolga Tanguler's departure. Amgen has looked within to replace its head of quality.

pipeline.title: Boehringer Ingelheim brings liver health education push to the NASCAR fast lane
pipeline.summary: "Driving Good Health" takes liver disease awareness to three NASCAR races this fall, with the last coming up at the Homestead-Miami Speedway Nov. 6 weekend.

pipeline.title: AHA: Novartis’ Lp(a) drug shows zero benefit, casting shadow over Amgen and Lilly programs
pipeline.summary: Novartis has lifted the lid on data from its failed cardiovascular outcomes trial, reporting a total absence of efficacy that could intensify questions about upcoming readouts from Amgen and Eli Lilly.

pipeline.title: RevMed’s Rasonque debut nets ‘eye-popping’ $198M in 5 weeks, even as exec tempers expectations
pipeline.summary: After roughly one month on the market, Revolution Medicines’ RAS inhibitor daraxonrasib is living up to its much-hyped potential, with an initial sales performance that more than one group of analysts considers “eye-popping.”

pipeline.title: Generate CEO sees ‘huge opportunity’ from using Claude to shorten CAR-T cell engines
pipeline.summary: Generate Biomedicines' CEO has hailed the “huge opportunity” offered by AI tools after the Flagship-founded company used Anthropic's Claude AI platform to reduce the size of CAR-T cell engines.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca said to offer $10B to acquire Rhythm, analysts whisper of a bidding war
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca has made a roughly $10 billion offer to purchase rare obesity disease player Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, The Wall Street Journal reports. At least three teams of analysts suggest a bidding war could be brewing and that Rhythm is unlikely to settle for AZ’s current pitch.

pipeline.title: VintaBio assets go on auction block as CGT viral vector demand slows
pipeline.summary: VintaBio, which debuted in 2023 as a CDMO focused on cranking out viral vectors for cell and gene therapy production, is having its manufacturing facility and intellectual property put up for sale.

pipeline.title: Agios aims to shed over 100 R&D roles this year ahead of hoped-for sickle cell disease approval
pipeline.summary: Agios Pharmaceuticals has been shrinking its R&D headcount over the course of 2026 as the commercial-stage company looks to eliminate more than 100 roles by year-end.

pipeline.title: Alnylam seeks new commercial leader as Tolga Tanguler exits amid faltering Amvuttra trajectory
pipeline.summary: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking a new chief commercial officer as the biopharma announced that its six-year CCO veteran, Tolga Tanguler, is leaving the company.

pipeline.title: Vanda drives straight into FDA trouble with fast-paced Nereus ad
pipeline.summary: Vanda Pharmaceuticals’ action-packed TV ad for motion-sickness drug Nereus has irked the FDA, which accused (PDF) the company of creating a misleading impression of the drug’s safety and effectiveness.

pipeline.title: With oncology pipeline at ‘inflection point,’ Merck puts finish line in focus with new corporate campaign
pipeline.summary: In “From Our Pipeline to the Finish Line,” Merck highlights its vision of a cancer-free future and the role it hopes its pipeline will play in achieving that goal.

pipeline.title: Advanced Analytics Help Reduce Control Animal Use While Preserving Scientific Rigor
pipeline.summary: Advanced analytics leverage curated historical controls on new studies, supporting fewer animals while preserving scientific rigor.

pipeline.title: Looking Beyond the First Answer Towards Delivering Impact
pipeline.summary: Science rarely moves in a straight line. Philippe Lopes-Fernandes explores how an unexpected turn can reveal a credible path to progress.

pipeline.title: Asking More of Science: How Daiichi Sankyo Is Challenging Assumptions About the Future of Cancer Care
pipeline.summary: See how Daiichi Sankyo is asking more of science to bring the next wave of innovation to patients.

pipeline.title: Regulatory tracker: J&J pushes Rybrevant beyond lung cancer with new subQ FDA nod
pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Foundayo sets new Rx record as Wegovy pill rebounds to prior high
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.
